apps.name: OpenNOW Debug
apps.localizedDescription: AV1/ProMotion pacing test for iPad 4K 120 FPS 10-bit HDR. Requests a fixed maximum display refresh range, avoids copying every compressed AV1 frame, removes recurring CPU pixel inspection and keeps console writes outside GPU callbacks. Adds bounded local numeric performance logs for decode, transport, presentation gaps and thermal/power state. Device build and five targeted tests passed; live iPad performance improvement still needs testing. Retains HEVC Main10, catalog/imports and Safari Home Screen links.
